pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×641 night courtyard photograph. Golden pointed bulb dome, two cylindrical gold minarets with projecting balconies and narrower upper stages; open gold/light-column entrance portico with pointed arches and blue/pale faience bands. Earlier open courtyard is visible. Festival red lighting, flags, crowds, banners, inscriptions and fine artwork not copied.

pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×720 covered courtyard/interior view: two levels of pointed faience fields, patterned soffits and rectangular rooflights. This view supports the covered court and coarse pale/blue material rhythm; it does not control the exterior dome profile or exact rooflight plan. Chandeliers, people and fine art omitted.
